primary_panel_metric.name: mean_angle_block16
primary_panel_metric.aggregation: angle per paired native residual; mean over all valid matched prediction positions including prefill; prompt-level pending-minus-completed contrast

rotation.PC_fit: baseline TRAIN only; shared basis and center across conditions
rotation.metric: causal next-state SSE in full coordinates; common persistence outside fitted subspace; score 1-SSE/SSE_persistence
rotation.surrogate_candidate: shared Fourier phase across channels per trajectory; exact circular cross-covariance preservation before recording quantization
rotation.surrogate_stopping_rule: Reject if it retains planted linear rotation; no real surrogate significance or rotation claim without a validated null. No alternative-null search.
rotation.sensitivity_rule: report all synthetic cases; require proper_rotation and midpoint_cayley positive full-space gain and improvement over drift/contraction on at least 3/4 held-out pure-rotation prompts; noisy cases quantify loss of sensitivity rather than trigger parameter changes.

propagation.training_mean_depth_profile: position 0 only, per layer transition learned on same four TRAIN prompts; full-width velocity error/causal next-state error versus persistence
